['run the CLI to preprocess IWSLT17 bitext data with BPE, BBPE, byte, or char vocabularies', 'run the script to convert XML segment files into plain text bitext format', 'run MosesTokenizer to pretokenize source and target language text files for NMT', 'run SentencepieceBPE to apply a trained BPE model to tokenize text files', 'run ByteBPE to apply a trained byte-level BPE model to tokenize text files', 'build a GRUTransformerModel by calling build_encoder with args, source dictionary, and embed tokens', 'build a GRUTransformerEncoder with args, dictionary, and embed tokens to create a bidirectional GRU contextualized encoder', 'review the GRUTransformerEncoder forward_embedding method that contextualizes token embeddings through a bidirectional GRU layer', 'configure the gru_transformer base architecture with default encoder and decoder dimensions of 512 and 2048', 'configure the gru_transformer_big architecture with larger 1024 encoder dimensions and 16 attention heads']
